skill.name: genlayer-erc7710-connector
skill.description: Connect GenLayer Intelligent Contract decisions to ERC-7710-style delegated authority. Use when an agent needs to design the interface, message schema, relayer/bridge path, EVM revocation controller, constraint updates, proof/finality assumptions, and failure handling that turn a GenLayer agent-performance review into ERC-7710 revocation or policy changes.
skill.summary: Design connector paths that turn GenLayer decisions into ERC-7710 revocation, constraints, and EVM redemption checks.
skill.author: internet-court

content.value_statement: Cross-chain delegation revocation designs can miss trust boundaries and finality assumptions. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through connector modes, payloads, controller checks, and failure tests.
actual_capabilities: Selects manual relay, trusted relayer, bridge, optimistic relay, or verified bridge modes.
Defines GenLayerDelegationDecision payload fields and relay envelope requirements.
Maps continue, warn, constrain, revoke, and escalate decisions to EVM effects.
Specifies revocation controller surfaces and ERC-7710 redemption checks.
Lists failure cases and tests for stale, duplicate, forged, or wrong-permission decisions.
limitations: Does not teach GenLayer contract deployment or CLI operations.
Does not provide production bridge proofs or deployed contracts.
Requires an existing mandate, ERC-7710 policy, and GenLayer review flow.
Security depends on the chosen relay trust model and finality assumptions.

use_cases.title: Prototype Cross-Chain Revocation
use_cases.description: Plan a demo where a GenLayer decision updates or revokes an ERC-7710 permission on Base Sepolia.

use_cases.title: Design a Trusted Watcher MVP
use_cases.description: Define watcher finality rules, signed relay payloads, allowlisted keys, event logs, and emergency revoke paths.

use_cases.title: Review Production Assumptions
use_cases.description: Compare optimistic relay and verified bridge options before making production-grade security claims.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Connector Mode
prompt_templates.prompt: I have a GenLayer review result and an ERC-7710 permission. Recommend the simplest connector mode and list its trust assumptions.

prompt_templates.title: Define the Relay Payload
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft the GenLayer decision payload fields for one mandate. Include replay protection, expiry, finality, and the EVM effect.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Controller Integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Design the EVM revocation controller interface and explain where ERC-7710 redemption should check revoke, pause, and constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Failure Cases
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced user validating a full design.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my connector plan for forged decisions, stale messages, duplicate relays, front-running, relayer outage, and wrong permission hashes.

output_examples.input: I need a Base Sepolia demo that uses the GenLayer Studio bridge boilerplate.
output_examples.output: A connector plan with bridge trust assumptions, source checks, receiver allowlisting, controller actions, and demo-focused safety limits.

output_examples.input: Review a trusted relayer design before I implement it.
output: Failure tests for stale, duplicate, forged, and wrong-permission messages.

output_examples.input: Explain how a revoke decision changes ERC-7710 redemption.
output_examples.output: A decision-to-effect mapping that shows how the controller records revocation and blocks future permission use.

best_practices: State the connector mode and trust assumptions before describing implementation details.
Keep replay protection, expiry, finality, and emergency revoke controls in every design.
Test stale decisions, duplicate messages, forged payloads, and wrong permission hashes.
anti_patterns: Do not claim GenLayer cancels ERC-7710 without an EVM-side enforcement path.
Do not use verified bridge language unless proof verification is implemented.
Do not omit absolute permission expiry or emergency owner revocation.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy GenLayer contracts?
faq.answer: No. It assumes the GenLayer review flow already exists and focuses on connector design.

faq.question: Can it design a hackathon demo?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports manual relay and GenLayer Studio bridge demo paths with explicit trust assumptions.

faq.question: Can it support production designs?
faq.answer: It can structure production discussions, but production claims require real proof or bridge verification.

faq.question: What EVM component enforces a decision?
faq.answer: An EVM controller, account module, caveat enforcer, or delegation manager integration must enforce the decision.

faq.question: What decisions are covered?
faq.answer: The guidance covers continue, warn, constrain, revoke, and escalate outcomes.

faq.question: Which agents can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
